independent_reconstruction.method: Reconstructed the emitted byte string in memory from the frozen assembler templates, current manifest, and current payload files; compared byte-for-byte with the private emitted script; compiled both reconstructed and emitted scripts without executing them.

limitations: This review verifies emitted startup bytes and static ordering only; it did not execute or contact the B host.
The in-unit import/read-sentinel execution is covered by the separate pinned TEST_RECEIPT smoke; this startup review did not run the remote unit.

startup_gate_review.capped_command: One serial systemd user service at 50% CPU, 1.4GB MemoryHigh, 1.5GB MemoryMax, no swap, 600s, hidden CUDA, BLAS/OpenMP threads=1, physical B research_tmp.
startup_gate_review.cli_order: The fresh CLI checks full manifest/canonical byte pins, compact stored R7 result hash and structure, runtime versions, sample and membership hashes, and the metadata fixture before importing/path-checking runtime modules and calling the R1 sample loader.
startup_gate_review.payload_gate: Every embedded payload has path-whitelist, byte-count, SHA and create-only checks; the complete staged bundle and six canonical sources are rehashed before the capped service starts.
startup_gate_review.preflight_and_fresh_exec: Inside the capped unit, the inline entry imports the pinned runtime closure under numpy.load/ParquetFile/torch.load sentinels, records module paths and verifies runtime closure, restores readers, then execv-replaces itself with a fresh Python process running the pinned CLI and fixed R3 sample/R7 result/manifest identities.
startup_gate_review.preimport_checks: The outer body checks the fixed F3 index-3 plan/heartbeat, exact populated-child ownership and active controller/worker, aggregate CPU/RAM reservations and headroom, no swap/OOM, physical scratch and disk/host memory, expected GPU ownership, sample SHA, six canonical source SHAs, and absent output/unit/support paths before staging or importing.
startup_gate_review.sample_and_output: Fixed R3 sample hash and membership hash are passed; output is the distinct R8 path and is checked absent. No stored R7 arrays, checkpoint, NPZ, or model are loaded; R7 evidence is compact scalar JSON only.
